request.style: English, warm male solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, gentle strings, reverent and gentle, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From Jeconiah’s line in the captives' land
Shealtiel his son, holding the hand
Of Malchiram, Pedaiah, and Shenazzar
Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah

[Verse]
From Pedaiah’s house, Zerubbabel rose
With Shimei his brother, the line is closed
Meshullam and Hananiah, sons of the king
And Shelomith their sister, the bond is strong

[Chorus]
Hananiah, name in the royal genealogy
Son of Zerubbabel, part of the lineage
David’s blood flows on, through the exile’s night
The line of Judah, burning with light

[Verse]
The sons of Hananiah, Pelatiah and Jeshaiah
Continuing the path, the truth is laid
Through Rephaiah, Arnan, and Obadiah
Shecaniah’s sons, in the books displayed

[Chorus]
Hananiah, name in the royal genealogy
Son of Zerubbabel, part of the lineage
David’s blood flows on, through the exile’s night
The line of Judah, burning with light

[Bridge]
No throne is built in the city stone
But names are kept in the book alone
The house of David, preserved and true
In Chronicles’ pages, written for you

[Outro]
The line continues, the story stands
Hananiah’s name, in the promised lands
